svg.text: HOW AEGIS OS CONNECTS & AUTHENTICATES TO HAL CORE
Zero SSH · 7-gate cryptographic admission in hal-gateway · server-enforced TrustDomain::RemoteExternal
Not revoked (checked on auth & every RPC)
HMAC sig + expiry + subject & max_risk_tier <= peer cap
Every allow & deny decision is appended to SHA-256 hal-audit
KEY SECURITY INVARIANTS FOR LAPTOP AGENTS
Zero SSH access · Server assigns RemoteExternal principal · Nonce replay blocked · L2 requires physical HAL Key tap
